entries.6d74650d9c18c2d6: Its management philosophy is 'Yumegen – Turning Dreams into Reality', and under the mission of 'creating new value in real estate and challenging the dreams and rich lives of all people', it has set a long-term vision toward 2030 of 'creating sustainable economic and social value through the real estate business'. Its three-year 3rd Medium-Term Management Plan, with the fiscal year ended December 2025 as its first year, makes 'expansion of business domains' and 'creation of new value' the axes of its business strategy, and states that it will work on improving sales productivity and expanding sales areas in its core purchase-and-resale business, expanding the asset types it handles, and growing its real estate development business and specified joint real estate business. Because the plan's numerical targets concern future matters, they are not transcribed here.
